Root.title: Add a Todo
Root.faq.whatDoesThisDo.answer: Adding a Todo will add an issue to your Todo list. You will get daily reminders about your Todo issues until you mark them as complete.
Root.faq.differentFromFlagging: How is this different from flagging a post?
Root.faq.differentFromFlagging.answer: Todo issues are disconnected from posts. You can generate Todo issues from posts but they have no other association to the posts. This allows for a cleaner Todo list that does not rely on post history or someone else not deleting or editing the post.
